knowledge:
- key_parameters: nCores=Integer specifying the number of parallel threads to use (default is 2; set to 0 to use all available cores) ;; depth=Optional vector of alternate sequencing depths (e.g., log of scran size factors) to correct for instead of the default sum of expression ;; doNorm=Logical parameter in SeuratFromDino; set to FALSE if the input matrix is already normalized ;; doLog=Logical parameter in SeuratFromDino; controls whether to log-transform the normalized expression matrix (e.g., log(x + 1))
- alternatives: Scran method (calculateSumFactors from the scran package) can be used to compute alternate sequencing depth size factors to pass into Dino ;; Scale-factor normalization (which Dino converges to in the limit of its concentration parameter gamma)
- when_to_use: Use when normalizing single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) UMI count data (such as 10x Genomics, Drop-seq, or inDrop) characterized by high proportions of zeros (shallow sequencing) and cellular heterogeneity.
- pitfalls: Dino does not correct for batch or other sample-specific effects unless they are correlated with sequencing depth ;; User caution is advised if applying Dino to non-UMI sequencing protocols ;; Genes lacking a minimum of non-zero expression should be filtered out prior to normalization (Dino defaults to scaling instead of resampling for genes with < 10 non-zero samples; filtering genes with < 20 non-zero samples is recommended) ;; When providing alternate sequencing depths, the median depth should not be far from 1.

workflows.name: standard_matrix_normalization_and_seurat
workflows.intent: Filter and normalize a raw UMI count matrix using Dino, then convert it to a Seurat object for downstream clustering and visualization.
input: pbmcSmall (raw UMI count matrix with genes on rows and cells on columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Filter out genes with low non-zero expression ;; 2. Normalize the UMI count matrix using Dino ;; 3. Convert the normalized matrix into a Seurat object using SeuratFromDino ;; 4. Run downstream Seurat clustering and visualization (FindVariableFeatures, ScaleData, RunPCA, FindNeighbors, FindClusters, RunUMAP, DimPlot)
workflows.code:
pbmcSmall <- pbmcSmall[rowSums(pbmcSmall != 0) >= 20, ]
pbmcSmall_Norm <- Dino(pbmcSmall)
pbmcSmall_Seurat <- SeuratFromDino(pbmcSmall_Norm, doNorm = FALSE)
pbmcSmall_Seurat <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmcSmall_Seurat, 
                        selection.method = "mvp")
pbmcSmall_Seurat <- ScaleData(pbmcSmall_Seurat, 
                        features = rownames(pbmcSmall_Norm))
pbmcSmall_Seurat <- RunPCA(pbmcSmall_Seurat, 
                        features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmcSmall_Seurat),
                        verbose = FALSE)
pbmcSmall_Seurat <- FindNeighbors(pbmcSmall_Seurat, dims = 1:10)
pbmcSmall_Seurat <- FindClusters(pbmcSmall_Seurat, verbose = FALSE)
pbmcSmall_Seurat <- RunUMAP(pbmcSmall_Seurat, dims = 1:10)
DimPlot(pbmcSmall_Seurat, reduction = "umap")

workflows.name: single_cell_experiment_normalization
workflows.intent: Normalize scRNA-seq data formatted as a SingleCellExperiment object using Dino.
workflows.stages: 1. Create a SingleCellExperiment object from the count matrix ;; 2. Run Dino normalization directly on the SingleCellExperiment object using Dino_SCE ;; 3. Inspect or extract the normalized counts using normcounts
workflows.code:
pbmc_SCE <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list("counts" = pbmcSmall))
pbmc_SCE <- Dino_SCE(pbmc_SCE)
str(normcounts(pbmc_SCE))

workflows.name: custom_depth_normalization
workflows.intent: Normalize a UMI count matrix using Dino with custom sequencing depths calculated via Scran size factors.
workflows.stages: 1. Compute size factors using Scran's calculateSumFactors ;; 2. Run Dino normalization with the depth parameter set to the log of the computed size factors
workflows.code:
scranSizes <- calculateSumFactors(pbmcSmall)
pbmcSmall_SNorm <- Dino(pbmcSmall, nCores = 1, depth = log(scranSizes))
